\section[sevódnya]{\ru{сегодня} (sevódnya) — today}

\label{lesson:RU-C69-today}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Russian for a year, then the Russian for the evening.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ru{сегодня}}
\textbf{\ru{сегодня}} (\emph{sevódnya}) — \textquotedblleft{}today\textquotedblright{}. The \textbf{\ru{г}} is said as \emph{v}.

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for today, yesterday, hour, minute, time.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright

\end{itemize}
